item.title: Point Of Law wins Melbourne Cup 2026
item.description: Melbourne Cup favourite Point of Law, formerly owned by King Charles, has won the 2026 Melbourne Cup, taking home AUD$10.2 million in prize money. The British horse was ridden by Ethan Brown.
item.content:encoded:
Melbourne Cup favourite Point of Law, formerly owned by King Charles, has won the 2026 Melbourne Cup, taking home AUD$10.2 million in prize money.

The British horse was ridden by Ethan Brown.

Zahrann has finished second and Juja Kibo third.

Winning jockey, Brown says it is every jockey's dream to do this, as he cannot still believe the win.

Trainer Ciaron Maher started seven of the 23 runners and he has trained the Melbourne Cup trifecta with Point of Law, Zahrann, and Juja Kibo

Royal Supremacy who had led for most of the race was pipped by Point Of Law at the tape.

item.title: Melbourne Cup fever builds at Suva betting shops ahead of 4pm race
item.description: The race that stops a nation is generating hype and excitement at various betting shops around Suva as punters gear up for the Melbourne Cup race at 4pm today. Speaking from Grants Betting Shop in Nabua, Navneet Singh says it is another exciting year for the Melbourne Cup, with all the horses expected to put up a strong performance.
item.content:encoded:
The race that stops a nation is generating hype and excitement at various betting shops around Suva as punters gear up for the Melbourne Cup race at 4pm today.

Speaking from Grants Betting Shop in Nabua, Navneet Singh says it is another exciting year for the Melbourne Cup, with all the horses expected to put up a strong performance.

Singh says customers have been arriving early at the shop, while phone calls from punters have kept staff members busy.
